focus: Penske and Budget truck-rental desks with Atlanta addresses (Downtown, Lindbergh/Buckhead, Cumberland, Perimeter, Upper Westside, West Fulton, and near the airport), plus three labor-only crews based in Norcross, Stone Mountain, and Alpharetta that serve Atlanta
intro: This first Atlanta page covers official Penske and Budget truck-rental locations whose own location pages list an Atlanta address — including three Home Depot desks open seven days a week until 7:30 PM — plus three labor-only movers whose own sites publish a metro Atlanta address and say they will load or unload a truck or container you already have. It is not a complete citywide inventory, and it does not report live truck counts; U-Haul, Enterprise, and most suburbs are not covered yet. One-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page mentions those services. If you already have a truck or container, use the labor-only filter or the HireAHelper box further down the page.
